annotation.title_clean: Towards trustworthy AI in the EU public administration: The EDPS Compass for its new role under the AI Act, 2026–2027
annotation.title_en: Towards trustworthy AI in the EU public administration: The EDPS Compass for its new role under the AI Act, 2026–2027
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: EDPS strategy document setting out how it will act as market surveillance authority and notified body for AI systems used by EU institutions under the AI Act in 2026–2027. It defines four pillars: supervision, AI Board contribution, institutional empowerment, and international engagement. No robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: EDPS is market surveillance authority for AI systems of EU institutions and notified body for certain high-risk biometric systems.
Four pillars: supervision, AI Act governance coordination, institutional empowerment, international engagement.
Internal safeguards will ensure impartiality when combining MSA and notified body roles.
Plans a Trustworthy AI Centre of Excellence and interinstitutional knowledge exchange.
Priorities may be adjusted following the Digital Omnibus proposal and forthcoming harmonised standards.
